seeding.title: Seeding
seeding.subtitle: Generate and manage tournament seeding
seeding.noEventsDescription: You must create at least one event in the Events tab before you can manage and configure team seeds.
seeding.statusNoticeDescription: Seeding can only be configured and locked when the tournament status is Open Registration. Current tournament status is {{status}}.

emptyState.title: No Seeds Generated
emptyState.description: Generate seeds based on player ratings and records to setup the tournament brackets.

instructions.title: Seeding Instructions:
instructions.item1: Use Auto Seed to generate seeding based on player ratings and records
instructions.item2: Drag and drop teams to manually adjust seeding order
instructions.item3: Lock individual seeds to prevent changes during auto-seeding
instructions.item4: Click "Lock Seeding" when finalized to prevent further modifications
